threat_event: Ransomware delivered by a phishing email encrypts workstations and the synced shared drive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing awareness training; desktop sync client would carry encrypted files into the shared drive and then into the backup; backup never restore-tested
likelihood_basis: EV-027 (training at hire only); EV-006 (shared drive synced to desktops); EV-015 (no restore jobs); EV-012 (no EDR in MSP services)
existing_controls: MFA on EHR and email; MSP patching and antivirus; firewall
treatment_plan: Annual training plus quarterly phishing simulations; MSP-managed endpoint detection and response (EDR) with alert monitoring; backup versioning extended to 90 days with immutable retention; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Exfiltration of PHI during a ransomware attack (double extortion) leads to a reportable breach of about 3,500 patients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PHI in email and the shared drive; no inventory of where ePHI lives; no alerting on large uploads
likelihood_basis: EV-035 (where ePHI is held); EV-004 (no download or forwarding alerts); EV-031 (about 3,500 active patients)
existing_controls: Firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic
treatment_plan: ePHI inventory; move scanned records out of email into the EHR; enable productivity suite alerts for mass download and forwarding rules; EDR (R-001)

threat_event: Business email compromise of a staff mailbox exposes PHI in email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA in place but staff approve push prompts without checking; no phishing training
likelihood_basis: EV-041 (staff approve push prompts without checking); EV-004 (number matching off); EV-027 (training records)
existing_controls: MFA on email
treatment_plan: Switch MFA to number matching; training (R-001); block automatic external forwarding

threat_event: Former workforce member signs in to the EHR or email after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terminations handled when remembered; former MA account found active after 3 months (disabled 2026-07-21)
likelihood_basis: EV-001 (April 2026 termination); EV-042 (accounts active about 3 months); EV-035 (no termination checklist)
existing_controls: Unique EHR logins; MFA tied to the user's phone
treatment_plan: Termination checklist: EHR, email, fax, and MSP accounts disabled on the last day; monthly account reconciliation by the Office Manager

threat_event: Shared-drive data cannot be restored after deletion, corruption, or encryption
threat_source: Backup misconfiguration or sync of damaged files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sync-based backup keeps only 30 days of versions; never restore-tested; one MSP admin account
likelihood_basis: EV-015 (30-day versions; no restore jobs); EV-006 (sync client carries changes into the shared drive)
existing_controls: Nightly copy by the backup service
treatment_plan: First restore test by the MSP; 90-day versioning with immutable retention; quarterly restore tests recorded

threat_event: Productivity suite vendor handles ePHI without a business associate agreement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BAA offered in the admin console but never accepted; PHI emailed and stored in the shared drive daily
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (suite BAA not accepted); EV-006 (PHI in the shared drive)
existing_controls: Business plan that offers a BAA
treatment_plan: Accept the BAA in the admin console and file a copy (completed 2026-08-14)

threat_event: Theft of an unencrypted desktop exposes cached PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 desktops unencrypted; synced shared-drive files and ECG results stored locally
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (6 desktops unencrypted); EV-033 (ECG results on the procedure-room workstation)
existing_controls: Office locked after hours; alarm
treatment_plan: MSP enables full-disk encryption on all 6 desktops and reports status monthly

threat_event: Workforce member views patient records without a job need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No audit log or EHR access report review; small community where staff know patients
likelihood_basis: EV-003 (no access report runs); EV-043 (Office Manager interview)
existing_controls: Unique EHR logins; role-based EHR access
treatment_plan: Monthly EHR access report review (employee and family look-ups); sanctions rule in POL-02

threat_event: EHR vendor outage longer than the 4-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No downtime procedure; single SaaS dependency for charts, schedule, and prescribing
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no downtime procedure); EV-021 (vendor RTO 4 h)
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 availability commitments
treatment_plan: Downtime kit (printed next-day schedule, paper visit forms); confirm vendor RTO and RPO in the contract

threat_event: Internet outage stops access to every SaaS system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet line; no failover
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (one internet line, no failover)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: MSP installs a cellular failover router; physician phone hotspot as a stopgap

threat_event: AI scribe vendor processes visit audio without a BAA or uses it to train models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot started before the BAA was signed; data-use terms not reviewed
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (trial since 2026-06-01; unsigned draft BAA; standard data-use terms); EV-017 (BAA folder)
existing_controls: Pilot limited to one physician
treatment_plan: Pause recording until the BAA is signed with no-training and deletion terms (see P10)

threat_event: Visits recorded by the AI scribe without every party's prior consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Verbal notice only; consent not documented; companions in the room not asked
likelihood_basis: EV-041 (associate physician interview: verbal notice only)
existing_controls: Physician tells the patient about the scribe
treatment_plan: Written notice at check-in; documented consent of all parties in the note before recording (see P10)

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool gives attackers access to every endpoint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has administrator access to all devices; no review of MSP security practices
likelihood_basis: EV-018 (remote tool reaches every computer; no incident notice term); EV-041 (MSP states MFA on its console, no evidence supplied)
existing_controls: BAA with MSP; MSP uses MFA on its own console (stated, not evidenced)
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security review (questionnaire and evidence of MFA, technician list, subcontractors); require notice of tool incidents within 24 hours in the next contract

threat_event: OCR enforcement after a complaint or breach because the risk analysis and policies are out of date
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Last risk analysis a 2019 checklist; purchased policies never adopted; no device or ePHI inventory
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (2019 checklist); EV-024 (template binder never adopted); EV-009 (device list has computers only)
existing_controls: 2026 risk analysis (this register)
treatment_plan: Adopt P06 policies; annual risk analysis update; device and ePHI inventory

threat_event: Staff do not recognize or report an incident, so breach clocks are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident response plan; no reporting channel; training only at hire
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no incident response plan); EV-027 (training at hire only); EV-035 (past events handled informally)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-03 and P08 runbook; reporting rule in annual training; tabletop exercise

threat_event: Fax or email containing PHI sent to the wrong recipient
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No verification step for new fax numbers or email addresses
likelihood_basis: EV-035 (misdirected fax); EV-041 (no second check for new fax numbers)
existing_controls: Cloud fax cover sheet
treatment_plan: Saved contacts for frequent recipients; double-check rule in training

threat_event: Unpatched firewall or Wi-Fi firmware exploited for remote access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware patched by the MSP but no vulnerability scanning
likelihood_basis: EV-012 (no vulnerability scanning); EV-014 (no inbound services exposed)
existing_controls: MSP patching; no management interface exposed to the internet
treatment_plan: Quarterly external vulnerability scan by the MSP; report to the Office Manager

threat_event: ECG and spirometry results stored only on the procedure-room workstation are lost or exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Results saved locally before import; workstation unencrypted and not backed up
likelihood_basis: EV-033 (results held on the procedure-room workstation); EV-011 (workstation unencrypted)
existing_controls: Results imported into the EHR the same day
treatment_plan: Encrypt the workstation (R-007); import results the same day and delete local copies weekly

threat_event: Hurricane closes the office for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan or alternate location; single office
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no contingency plan); EV-033 (one office suite)
existing_controls: SaaS EHR reachable from any location; laptops encrypted
treatment_plan: Short contingency plan: laptops home with physicians before landfall, telehealth and phone visits, patient notice script

threat_event: Clearinghouse outage delays claims
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single clearinghouse through the EHR vendor
likelihood_basis: EV-019 (one clearinghouse through the EHR vendor); EV-030 (cash reserve)
existing_controls: Payer portals for urgent claims
treatment_plan: Accepted: payers accept late claims within filing limits; cash reserve covers 30 days

threat_event: Lost or stolen laptop or tablet exposes PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Devices leave the office with physicians
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (laptops and tablets encrypted; remote wipe); EV-035 (lost phone in 2025)
existing_controls: Laptops encrypted; tablets encrypted with passcode; MSP can wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: PHI encrypted consistent with HHS guidance is not unsecured PHI (45 CFR 164.402); residual risk Low

threat_event: AI scribe inserts an error into a clinical note that leads to patient harm
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No output quality check in the pilot
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (no output quality check in the pilot); EV-041 (associate physician interview)
regulatory_driver: N62-R07 (45 CFR 92.210 if used to support clinical decisions); N62-R01
existing_controls: Physician signs every note
treatment_plan: Review attestation at signing; monthly 10-note sample (see P10)

threat_event: Attacker exploits missing patches on the procedure-room workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP excluded the workstation from patching since April 2026 at the device vendor's request (found in P07 testing)
likelihood_basis: EV-SI-2 (patch exclusion found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Behind the office firewall; no internet browsing on it
treatment_plan: MSP applies vendor-approved patches monthly; exclusions require written Office Manager approval
